glyph_rationales.the box lid — the destination already vi: The lid: the picture on the box shows what the pieces will become and supplies the criterion by which every placement is judged.
glyph_rationales.the edge frame — built first: The edge frame: set out first, it decides which edge is outside and which differences belong together.
glyph_rationales.the sorted pieces — each promising a pla: Sorting by marks: each successful fit confirms a small part of the anticipated whole.
glyph_rationales.the lid's silent power — it decides whic: The anomaly: under the lid, an apparent anomaly is merely a piece awaiting its correct position — the criterion never itself questioned.
glyph_rationales.the flat assembly — meeting a turn it ca: The flat arrangement: the maker encounters a turn it cannot preserve and a continuation beyond an edge.
glyph_rationales.the travelled world — curvature beyond t: The travelled world: the puzzle travels into the world it claims to depict, where apparent distortion changes with position.
glyph_rationales.recording how a view was made — from whe: The reconstruction requirement: recording from where, across which region, under what projection, with which omissions.
glyph_rationales.the pieces become charts — edges mark li: The new office: pieces become local charts whose edges mark limits of usable description and whose overlaps are operative seams.
glyph_rationales.the circle covered by two charts — oppos: The circle's two charts: each omits one pole; compactness is the obstruction to a single global chart.
glyph_rationales.the shared point (3/5, 4/5) — one point,: At (3/5,4/5): u=3 and v=1/3 name one point; the coordinates differ, the point does not.
glyph_rationales.the declared transformation v = 1/u — th: The overlap rule v=1/u: the declared transformation explains why differing reports agree in what they describe.
glyph_rationales.even motion is transformed — the same ch: du/dt=2 gives dv/dt=−2/9: both descriptions give the same change of height; giving both the number two would change the motion.
glyph_rationales.the torus — the flat quotient, one addre: T²=R²/Z²: one surface address with infinitely many plane representatives; the quotient tells how they are related.
glyph_rationales.the loop returning to its start — its wi: The loop [2t,−t]: it returns to [0,0] on the torus — local closure with retained displacement.
glyph_rationales.the lifted endpoint (2, -1) — the displa: The lift ends at (2,−1): the pair records winding, not the traveller's entire experience.
glyph_rationales.the disk abstraction — every loop contra: The disk abstraction: every loop contractible; what it lacks is the torus's independent, non-contractible winding classes.
glyph_rationales.four sides, two generators, one vertex,: The Euler count: four sides, two edge classes, one vertex, one face — counts that cannot be exchanged because a picture makes them look alike.
glyph_rationales.the planetary view — Earth gathered arou: The Blue Marble unit: a bounded view of Earth gathering attention around a shared planet, intelligible only through its position, instrument and production.
glyph_rationales.as box-lid — \"planetary\" the unexamine: As box-lid: the planetary picture settles in advance what the world is and what its pieces must mean.
glyph_rationales.whose planet, computed by whom, on whose: The gauge questions: breadth of view cannot by itself establish the authority of the account made through it.
glyph_rationales.the diaphanous turn — location, time, pr: The diaphanous use: the view acquires location and time, its production inspectable — the image keeps disclosing Earth while the viewer's relation to its power changes.
glyph_rationales.the atlas — charts with declared transit: The atlas: unity realised through crossings — one enters a chart, crosses an overlap, learns what changed, returns with the route available.
glyph_rationales.the first picture reopened — its achieve: The reopened picture: colours and local fits keep their achievement, now read with their frame, missed continuations and routes into other accounts.
glyph_rationales.the Mapper route — lens, cover, clusteri: The Mapper route: choose a lens, cover its range, pull the cover back, cluster, construct the nerve — retained choices make it answerable to its construction.
glyph_rationales.sheaf and obstruction — local data, rest: Sheaf methods: local data with restriction maps and compatibility; a genuine obstruction remains a result to expose, not a prohibition on computation.
glyph_rationales.the traveller — the atlas carried forwar: The traveller's return: the atlas carried forward — sufficiently definite to guide the next step, sufficiently answerable for the journey to change where it leads.
